  [-82.4480, 35.5960],
  [-82.4700, 35.5920],
  [-82.4800, 35.5900],
])

def prep_ls(img):
    qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL')
    mask = (qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)  # dilated cloud
            .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))  # cirrus
            .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))  # cloud
            .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))) # cloud shadow
    scaled = img.select(['SR_B4','SR_B3','SR_B5']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
    out = scaled.updateMask(mask).rename(['red','green','nir'])
    return out.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames())

def select_best(col):

def compute_ndti_stats(img):

    water = ndwi.gt(0.05)
    ndti = img.expression('(r - g) / (r + g)', {'r': img.select('red'), 'g': img.select('green')}).rename('ndti')
    ndti_w = ndti.updateMask(water).updateMask(img.select('red').mask())
    # Counts and mean
    water_px = ndti_w.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=scale, maxPixels=maxPixels
    ).get('ndti')
    ndti_mean = ndti_w.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=scale, maxPixels=maxPixels
    ).get('ndti')

            ndti_aug = res_aug['ndti']
            ndti_oct = res_oct['ndti']

            print(f"NDTI Δ (Oct02 - Aug30): {ndti_oct - ndti_aug:+.3f}")
            if (ndti_oct - ndti_aug) > thresh:

            else:
                print("B")
